newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 10 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 10 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it qualified 10 bond issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--Atlanta, Ga., $28.5 million of public improvement bonds and $8 million of various purpose GO bonds.
--McPherson County School District #423, Kan., $4 million of GO school bonds.
--Marshall, Minn., $2.3 million of tax increment bonds, $1.1 million of tax increment bonds and $4.9 million of tax increment bonds.
--St. Michael ISD #885, Minn., $$1.2 million and $3.5 million of GO refunding bonds.
--Avon Grove SD, Pa., $6.1 million and $9.9 million of GO bonds.
--Franklin Regional School District, Pa., $4.9 million of GO bonds.
--Flower Mound, Texas, $2.3 million of GO bonds.
--Glendale School District, Pa., $5 million of GO bonds. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
